authority: Wizards of the Coast (direct official capture)

current_official_source.document_effective_date_text: These rules are effective as of September 25, 2026.
current_official_source.rule_103_8a_exact_text: 103.8a In a two-player game, the player who plays first skips the draw step (see rule 504, “Draw Step”) of their first turn.
current_official_source.rule_103_8a_semantics: In a two-player game the player who plays first skips the draw step of their first turn. The step is skipped entirely, therefore no priority and no observation point exists inside it; the first observable checkpoint after the beginning phase is the precombat main phase.

new_rules.701.71a: 701.71a To empower Jace N means “If you don’t control a Jace planeswalker token, create a blue Jace planeswalker token with 0 loyalty, ‘[−1]: Surveil 1,’ and ‘[−3]: Draw a card.’ Choose a Jace planeswalker token you control. Put N loyalty counters on it.”

full107_impact_adjudication.WS05-CMD-START-2: SEMANTICS_CONFIRMED_STILL_CURRENT. The v1.0.6 successor requires the 2P starting player to skip the entire first-turn draw step, expose no priority inside it, emit no draw event, and reach precombat main as the first observable checkpoint. Rule 103.8a in the 2026-09-25 official TXT states exactly that and is byte-identical to 2026-08-19. The successor fixture requires the same. The contract's cited effective_date 2026-08-07 is superseded by 2026-09-25 but the semantic basis is unchanged.
full107_impact_adjudication.WS05-CMD-START-3: SEMANTICS_CONFIRMED_STILL_CURRENT. Rule 103.8c (unchanged) states that in all other multiplayer games no player skips the draw step of their first turn, so the 3P first-turn-draw obligation remains correct.
full107_impact_adjudication.other_105_rows: NO_QUALIFICATION_RELEVANT_DELTA. The only textual changes are combat-timing rule renumbering 506.7a-g to 506.8a-g (pure renumbering, text identical), a new token definition 111.10x (Heartwood), and a new planeswalker empower 701.71a (Jace). None is referenced by any of the 107 provider-denominator rows.

supersedes.effective_date_text: These rules are effective as of August 7, 2026.
supersedes.reason: This receipt named the 2026-08-07 TXT as the current official source and explicitly rejected the 2026-09-25 signal with disposition REJECTED_BY_HIGHER_AUTHORITY_CURRENT_OFFICIAL_RULES_PAGE, on the mechanism claim that the official page links the 20260807 TXT. The direct official capture falsifies that mechanism: the page links MagicCompRules 20260925 for DOCX, PDF and TXT, and the previously recorded 20260807 TXT URL now returns HTTP 404. The prior receipt also made no byte-exact claim (byte_exact_status NOT_CAPTURED_IN_THIS_COORDINATOR_SURFACE), so it could not have detected this.
supersedes.note: The superseded receipt's content is retained here rather than discarded. Historical authority provenance lives in qualification/manifests/AUTHORITY_LOCK_v2.json.
